evidence.quote: So then, it has actually gone last night, and not come again.
evidence.paraphrase: The learned man discovers his shadow has detached and departed from him.

evidence.quote: This annoyed him: not so much because the shadow was gone, but because he knew there was a story about a man without a shadow.
evidence.paraphrase: The man is annoyed by the loss and worried about resembling an existing tale.

evidence.quote: after the lapse of eight days he observed, to his great joy, that a new shadow came in the sunshine
evidence.paraphrase: A new shadow grows back for the man in the warm lands.

evidence.quote: Do you not know your old shadow? You certainly thought I should never more return.
evidence.paraphrase: The lost shadow returns years later, now embodied as a wealthy man.

evidence.quote: I never imagined that one's old shadow could come again as a man.
evidence.paraphrase: The learned man remarks on the strangeness of a shadow becoming a man.

evidence.quote: I was in want of boots, of clothes, of the whole human varnish that makes a man perceptible.
evidence.paraphrase: The shadow explains that clothing was what made him perceptible as a man.

evidence.quote: when the sun rose, and when the sun went down, I became so strangely great; in the moonlight I was very near being more distinct than yourself
evidence.paraphrase: The shadow describes how its size and distinctness changed with the sun and moon.

evidence.quote: the shadow was master, and the master was the shadow
evidence.paraphrase: The roles reverse so that the shadow becomes master and the man becomes the shadow.

evidence.quote: So she began, by degrees, to question him about the most difficult things she could think of, and which she herself could not have answered
evidence.paraphrase: The princess systematically tests the suitor's knowledge with hard questions.

evidence.quote: she almost pierced him through with her eyes
evidence.paraphrase: The princess, who sees too clearly, examines the shadow intently as she falls in love.

evidence.quote: The learned man heard nothing of all this\u2014for they had deprived him of life.
evidence.paraphrase: The learned man is put to death while the shadow marries the princess.

evidence.quote: Nay, this is going too far!\u201d said the learned man. \u201cI will not have it; I will not do it!
evidence.paraphrase: The learned man refuses the shadow's demand that he pose as its shadow.

evidence.quote: thou must submit to be called SHADOW by all and everyone; thou must not say that thou hast ever been a man
evidence.paraphrase: The shadow demands the man permanently take on the role and identity of a shadow.
